text:
Emma: Heads up — Acme Corp just asked to run a week-long POC. They want to test a custom model "Orchid-XL-v3" (not in our catalog) + two variants (FP16 and 4-bit quant) behind Dedicated capacity with VPC peering. Also need confirmation on commercial licensing (redistribution allowed?) and whether our tokenizer is compatible. Can SE/infra/sec weigh in?

Raj: @Emma thanks — what are the model artifacts? tar.gz with tokenizer.json? Any conversion already to HuggingFace format?

Emma: Customer provided a HF repo link: https://git.example/acme/orchid-xl — says tokenizer is SentencePiece. Model is ~28B dense, checkpoint has `pytorch_model.bin` and `config.json`.

Raj: Ok. Likely compatible but need to check: 1) vocab/merges vs spm, 2) EOS token handling, 3) KV cache keys shape for attention heads. Quick probe: can you drop me the model repo tag and sample input?

Emma: Tag is v3-2026-03-20. Sample prompt and a small eval set attached to the ticket.

Lee: From infra: 28B dense -> Dedicated or Private (on-prem) recommended. If they want 4-bit quant, we need to run quantization pipeline. Memory estimate: ~150GB GPU if FP16; 4-bit could fit into 80GB with sharding. Also need to confirm topologies: Triton vs runtime operator we use.

Maria: Security: they'll need us to fill SQA + share our KMS flow. Licensing: confirm whether model license allows commercial hosting; send me the repo license file. If it's Apache-like should be fine; if it's non-commercial, that's a blocker.

Raj: I'll run a quick compatibility scan (tokenizer + forward pass check) and create a sandbox run. Running command now:

```
# quick compatibility check
python probe_tokenizer.py --repo https://git.example/acme/orchid-xl --sample "Hello world"
python run_forward.py --model-dir /tmp/orchid_v3 --dtype fp16 --seq 512 --batch 2
```

deploy-bot: ticket #IN-7623 created: "Orchid-XL-v3 compatibility scan" assigned to @raj, watchers: @lee, @maria, @emma.

Raj: Scan results: tokenizer ok (SentencePiece), but config indicates rotary embeddings with non-standard base. Forward pass fails due to KV cache shape mismatch with our runtime (expected (heads, seq, head_dim) got (seq, heads, head_dim)). Need adapter patch — quick PR will fix.

Lee: I'll provision a Dedicated pool for POC: 2xA100-80GB reserved, autoscale policy with burst. Estimate cost for week-long POC w/ ~100k tokens/day: ~$4,200 incl infra & GPU reserved charges. Add licensing fee estimate after legal checks.

Maria: On security, license file is `LICENSE-NC.md` — it's non-commercial. That's a showstopper for hosting. Need customer confirmation they can relicense or provide a commercial license. Also request for VPC peering is acceptable but we need their org's CIDR and compliance docs.

Emma: Ok - action items: Raj to open PR to patch runtime adapter + deliver compatibility run log; Lee to stand up Dedicated pool and provide cost calc; Maria to draft SQA answers and confirm licensing ask with customer. I'll coordinate with Acme legal about relicensing. ETA by EOD tomorrow?

Raj: PR opened: https://git.internal/pr/4876 — patch applies a reshape and adds a tokenizer mapping tweak. Compatibility run successful on FP16 (small warmup). 4-bit quant pipeline needs to be tested next.

Lee: Dedicated pool provisioned (preview): pool-id d-poc-478, ETA for full readiness 4 hours. Cost calc posted in ticket.

Maria: SQA draft ready, flagged licensing as blocker. Sent message to Acme for licensing confirmation.

Emma: Thanks all. If Acme can provide commercial license, we can start 4-bit conversion and full POC. Otherwise suggest they provide a model under a compatible license or let us run POC on-prem as a one-off.

Emma: Next check-in tomorrow 10:00 PT. :calendar:
